human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Reorder and polish the existing result page so a judge understands the finding, caveat, measured signals, reason, next action, and evidence within seconds. Keep the homepage minimal and add at most one OpenAIRE positioning sentence. Depends on: 0001.result-semantics-freeze, 0003.evidence-chain, 0004.golden-demo-contracts.
human_pressure.why_now: The underlying product is already understandable; the remaining UI work should amplify evidence rather than introduce a new visual system.
do_not_misread: This is a hackathon freeze pack: improve credibility and demo reliability without widening the product surface.
Repository-specific file paths and validation commands must be mapped from the actual OpenGap repository before execution.
A measured imbalance is a signal, not proof of a scientific research gap.
red_lines: Do not add a new design-system dependency.
Do not add graph animations, dashboards, feature-card sections, or decorative architecture.
Do not hide the caveat below the evidence section.
Do not turn zero into an error state merely for visual emphasis.

machine_core.goal: Implement a minimal result-page hierarchy centered on the potential finding, uncertainty caveat, four measured entity signals, trend basis, why-flagged explanation, next scans, and evidence.
red_lines: Do not add a new design-system dependency.
Do not add graph animations, dashboards, feature-card sections, or decorative architecture.
Do not hide the caveat below the evidence section.
Do not turn zero into an error state merely for visual emphasis.
invariants: The topic and finding are the primary visual hierarchy.
Caveat is visible near the hero finding.
Publications, projects, software, and datasets are readable at a glance.
Trend has a visible basis or renders as insufficient data.
Dependency 0001.result-semantics-freeze must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
Dependency 0003.evidence-chain must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
Dependency 0004.golden-demo-contracts must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
contracts: Preferred result order is topic -> finding -> interpretation -> caveat -> measured signals -> why flagged -> suggested next scans -> evidence.
Homepage may add at most one supporting sentence explaining OpenAIRE cross-entity gaps.
Loading may show bounded narrative stages but no fake progress percentage.
failure_semantics: If a signal is unavailable, render unavailable rather than zero.
If trend basis is unavailable, render insufficient data.
If evidence is empty, keep the measured result and explain that representative records are unavailable rather than hiding the whole finding.

steps.title: Map current result and homepage components
details: Identify existing layout, signal list/cards, finding area, evidence area, example topics, and loading/error components.
Prefer edits over new components unless the existing structure makes extraction clearly cheaper.

steps.title: Reorder result hierarchy
details: Place finding and caveat above measured signals.

steps.title: Improve measured-signal presentation
details: Show zero as valid data and unavailable as a distinct state.
Expose a short trend measurement explanation.

steps.title: Tighten homepage positioning
details: Keep Find what is missing in research.
Add at most one line such as Detect measurable gaps across research, funding and reusable outputs using the OpenAIRE Graph.
Optionally retain a small Built with OpenAIRE Graph footer.

steps.title: Preserve basic accessibility
details: Maintain semantic headings, keyboard-accessible example topics, visible focus, and understandable external link labels.
Verify 1366x768 and mobile-width readability using existing project tooling/manual checks.

acceptance: A judge can identify the finding, caveat, and four entity counts quickly.
Zero and unavailable are visually distinct.
Trend exposes a basis or insufficient-data label.
Homepage stays minimal and OpenAIRE role is understandable.
Result UI remains usable on common laptop and mobile widths.

must_check: Measured signals are visible without being buried in prose.
No decorative feature expansion was introduced.
reject_if: The caveat is hidden or removed for visual simplicity.
A new design system or major visualization dependency is introduced.
UI treats missing data as zero.
The homepage becomes more complex than the current KISS product.
The implementation fabricates OpenAIRE counts, records, links, trends, or gap evidence.
The implementation expands the frozen MVP taxonomy beyond funding gap, reuse gap, and no strong structural gap.
The implementation weakens validation or changes validation commands merely to obtain a passing result.
The implementation modifies files outside the repository-mapped minimal scope for this pack.
The implementation introduces unrelated architecture or feature work.

completion_constraints: Inspect the actual OpenGap repository before filling file scope or commands.
Map only existing files that directly implement the behavior described by this pack.
New test files may be added only when the existing test layout clearly supports them and they are listed in machine_core.files.create.
Use exact runnable commands from the repository; no shell globs and no invented scripts.
After completion, perform a deterministic schema and scope recheck before coder execution.
